evidence.title: The Continent's Largest AI Compute Installation Is Now Under Construction
evidence.excerpt: Harch Corp's dated release says Harch Intelligence breaks ground on a Dakhla hyperscale data-center campus and labels the installation now under construction.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 39736-byte content-decoded official HTML response body
metadata.publication_date_verification: The page's NewsArticle structured data reports both datePublished and dateModified as 2026-03-15T00:00:00.000Z.
metadata.status_wording_as_reported: The Continent's Largest AI Compute Installation Is Now Under Construction; Harch Intelligence breaks ground on the infrastructure.
metadata.site_control_wording_as_reported: Harch Intelligence has secured a 50-hectare site in Dakhla, Morocco.
metadata.physical_status_scope: Site control alone would not qualify. The lifecycle observation rests only on the dated first-party headline and description explicitly saying now under construction and breaks ground. No foundations, shell, fit-out, commissioning, or progress substage is inferred.
metadata.currentness_scope: The record preserves a construction-start observation as of the 2026-03-15 publication date. Retrieval on 2026-07-21 confirms the official release remains available but is not treated as a new July physical-status update; July current status remains independently unverified.
metadata.capacity_scope: The source calls 500 MW a Pipeline and describes a first 100 MW module, without typing either as critical IT load, gross facility demand, grid connection, generation, installed or energized capacity, or current load. Both remain metadata and create no normalized capacity row.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The 500 MW and 100 MW figures are not added or converted. The source's future renewable-pipeline language creates no current grid connection, contracted supply, generation, consumption, annual energy, PUE, WUE, current load, or measured efficiency observation.
metadata.hardware_guardrail: The reported 1,798 carbon-optimized GPUs is promotional pipeline context, not dated evidence of installed, delivered, energized, accepted, or operating hardware, and creates no hardware or capacity observation.
metadata.workload_guardrail: Large-language-model training, real-time inference, and sovereign-AI wording describes the planned campus purpose only. It creates no current workload, tenant, customer, user, model, occupancy, or utilization observation.
metadata.role_scope: The release explicitly says Harch Intelligence secured the site and breaks ground, supporting a developer role. Harch Energy's future renewable pipeline does not establish a current utility, power supplier, generator, owner, operator, tenant, customer, or contractor role.
metadata.project_scope: One campus and one source-scoped initial development are represented. The first 100 MW module is not emitted separately because the release does not expressly assign the reported construction start to that module rather than the campus development.
metadata.territorial_guardrail: The country field follows the publisher's wording Dakhla, Morocco solely as source attribution. It does not adjudicate the internationally disputed territorial status of Dakhla or infer a sovereign boundary from maps or imagery.
